description.en: A Windows XP Luna notification card for DeepSeek Harness: every finished turn pops a topmost card in the bottom-right corner that stays until you dismiss it.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的 Windows XP Luna 风格通知卡片：每轮任务结束时在桌面右下角弹出置顶卡片，不手动关闭就不会消失。

description.en: Pops a bottom-right Windows XP Luna card when a turn finishes or the agent stops to ask you something. The card never closes itself: dismiss it with the close button, a right-click, or Esc. A settings page controls the switch, the filters, the sound, and DSH autostart.
description.zh: 每轮任务结束、或智能体停下来等你确认时，在桌面右下角弹出 Windows XP Luna 风格卡片。卡片不会自动消失，要用关闭按钮 / 右键 / Esc 手动关掉。设置页可开关、调参、试听提示音，并可设置开机自启 DSH。
